page_title: Convert Images to Editable Files | EditableImage

sources.entry: EditableImage - Turns a slide screenshot into an editable PowerPoint with real text boxes over a rebuilt background; also converts diagram pictures to draw.io and flat artwork to layered PSD. Paid credit packs with a one-time free trial of 10 credits for two conversions on signup; no ongoing free tier. #paid

summary.name: EditableImage
summary.one_liner: A web service that converts flat images into editable PowerPoint slides, Draw.io diagrams, layered PSD files, or formatted text (Markdown/TXT).
use_cases: Turn a screenshot of a slide into an editable PowerPoint
Recover a diagram picture as editable draw.io shapes and connectors
Split generated artwork into layered PSD files
Change a wrong word in an image while keeping the rest unchanged
Extract headings, lists and text from an image as Markdown or TXT
summary.what_it_does: The site offers five workflows: image to PowerPoint (exports a .pptx with recovered text boxes over a rebuilt background), image to Draw.io (exports standard .drawio XML with shapes attached to their arrows), edit text in an image (marks words, redraws only those lines, exports a PNG), image to layers (separates subject, objects and lettering onto transparent layers exported as PSD or PNG), and image to text (exports Markdown or TXT with headings, lists and font size/weight/colour info). Each workflow shows the original next to the editable result for comparison. The page says results should be reviewed, especially recovered layouts and generated lettering.
notable: Five output types: PPTX, Draw.io XML, layered PSD/PNG, redrawn PNG, Markdown/TXT
Draw.io diagram shapes stay attached to their connectors when moved
Image to Text keeps headings and lists as structure
Failed conversions refund credits; finished results reopen free for 24 hours
caveats: Requires an account; no free tier beyond 10 signup credits (enough for 2 conversions), and every run costs credits
Uploaded images are sent to third-party AI services for processing; server copies deleted after 24 hours
Recovered layouts and generated lettering need manual review before use
